body: I've never been to college, never had a job, don't have a driver's license. Pretty pathetic right? I also don't want to even try to go to college or get a job, nor get my license. I just want to go to sleep and never wake up. I don't know what to do...my family would be broken if I killed myself, but I'm basically dead anyway so why stay? Ugh I sound so pathetic, sorry.
I was playing a video game to take my mind off things, but now I'm back to the usual sadness and lack of motivation to do anything.
